files.start_fandom_tool.cmd:
@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions

set "BOOTSTRAP=%~dp0updater_bootstrap.ps1"
if not exist "%BOOTSTRAP%" goto bootstrap_missing

powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%BOOTSTRAP%"
set "RC=%ERRORLEVEL%"
if not "%RC%"=="0" pause
exit /b %RC%

:bootstrap_missing
echo Updater bootstrap was not found.
pause
exit /b 1
files.startup_update_check.ps1:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$bootstrap = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'updater_bootstrap.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bootstrap -PathType Leaf)) {
    Write-Host 'updater_bootstrap.ps1 was not found.'
    exit 1
}
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $bootstrap
exit $LASTEXITCODE
files.update_and_start.ps1:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$bootstrap = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'updater_bootstrap.ps1'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bootstrap -PathType Leaf)) {
    Write-Host 'updater_bootstrap.ps1 was not found.'
    exit 1
}
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $bootstrap -ForceUpdate -NoBrowser
exit $LASTEXITCODE
